capabilities: Show frontmatter titles instead of filenames in explorer, search, tabs, graph and more
Configure which UI surfaces display titles
Build titles from frontmatter keys using templates
Rewrite internal link text to the note's title
Expose an API for other plugins
extras: The listing is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The plugin is free software under GNU GPLv3 and never renames or edits files on disk; it only changes what Obsidian displays.
intentEvidence: Meaningful Name is a modified version of Front Matter Title by Snezhig
motivation: The author forked Front Matter Title, giving it a new plugin id so it installs separately, and changed it to read the name frontmatter key by default.
problem: Obsidian shows raw filenames everywhere, which is unreadable when notes are named with timestamps or random IDs.

relations.evidence: a modified version of Front Matter Title by Snezhig and its contributors
includes the API type definitions from Snezhig's front-matter-plugin-api-provider

summary: Displays a readable title from frontmatter in place of the filename across explorer, tabs, search, graph, links and other UI, without renaming files.
